methodology_note: NCRB PSI 2018 Tables 2.10C-2.13C combined (convicts + undertrials + detenues + other prisoners). Muslim share among prisoners whose religion was reported: sum of religion columns across STATES+UTs subtotals (= ALL-INDIA by construction; auto-excludes states that did not report religion, e.g. Maharashtra in several years). Muslim count: 88,890, religion-reported total: 439,108. Compare vs Muslim share of population ~14.23% (Census 2011).
